summary: testAppModelDerivesProjectBackedLoadFailureFromTheRuntimeKey (AnalyticsTests.swift:167-187) always re-selects the chat before firing its onPiLoadFailed callback, so is_project_chat is only ever asserted for the currently-active runtime; it can't distinguish the correct per-runtime key.projectID attribution (AppModel.swift:1057-58) from a regression that reads live selection state instead, even though cached background runtimes (conversationRuntimes, AppModel.swift:419) can legitimately fire onPiLoadFailed while a different chat is selected. No test exercises that case.
